turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Tauji! I was just thinking about you, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Hello Naveen, I am fine. Just this knee pain is bothering me a bit since morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why you should come to Delhi for a few days, the weather is very pleasant right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Delhi is too crowded for me, beta. I do not know if I can manage the travel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry about that, I will pick you up from the station. We can celebrate Diwali together this year.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Diwali is still some time away. Will your mother be okay with it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She is actually the one who insisted. She wants to make those special laddoos for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That sounds lovely. But who will look after the house here?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The neighbor's son will handle it. By the way, I sent nine thousand five hundred rupees to your account for the physiotherapy.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Why did you do that? I told you I have enough pension.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a small gift for your health, please do not argue with me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: You children are too stubborn. But thank you, I will use it for the medicines.
